script_text: The cosmos unleashes a massive powerful cosmic tidal surge that will sweep Pisces into unexpected depths this week. Tuesday and Wednesday bring Venus trine Neptune, softening relationship tensions and opening your 5th House to romantic possibilities. Thursday the Moon enters your 11th House, signaling a shift toward community networks and future aspirations. Thursday‑Friday the Venus‑Pluto sextile clears financial blockages, boosting your 2nd House earnings potential. Saturday‑Sunday the Sun‑Jupiter square eases, letting long‑term goals solidify and compassion guide actions. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines your 5th House, supercharging creativity and love. Tuesday’s Mars square Neptune creates emotional fog, so avoid major decisions when feelings feel overwhelming. Practice daily meditation during the Neptune trine to keep your watery energy balanced and focused. Follow for daily cosmic updates and deeper natal insights.
